work.title: Diptych Installation View 1
work.description: Gallery installation view showing two backlit framed collages mounted on a grey wall. Left panel features an american football, target rings, and photographic fragments; right panel displays sparse circular forms, vertical stripes, and gold disc elements on white ground.
